items.title: 68239_Ram Ramirez oral history interview
items.q: I hang out at a place called Percy Lee's at (?). ... Percy Lee. He was a fellow that owned one of the hideaways... when I went up to Percy Lee's, I couldn't get to him.

ctx.x: And therefore, I said, 'Where are you going to be playing? Where do you hang out?' 'I hang out at a place called Percy Lee's at (?).' 'Okay, I'll be there.' So I said, 'Oh my goodness, I'm going to get close to him.'
